title: EventsPublishRequest
description: events.publish-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/events on OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish for services, events.app.publish for developer apps): one events.event-envelope@1, or a batch { events: [...] } of 1 to 100 envelopes stored all or nothing. trace_id, priority (important) and visibility (internal) default when left out. source must be the caller and event_type one of its prefixes (an app: app-<ULID> and app.<project_key>.*, actor the app or the user it acts for).
